description: This file defines a Drupal event subscriber class 'SecurityFileUploadEventSubscriber' that sanitizes filenames during file uploads to prevent security issues by enforcing filename rules and extensions.

classes.name: SecurityFileUploadEventSubscriber
classes.description: A Drupal event subscriber class that intercepts file upload filename sanitization events to enforce security rules and filename sanitization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting the configuration factory dependency.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events this subscriber listens to, specifically the 'file.upload.sanitize.name' event, with 'sanitizeName' as the handler.

methods.name: sanitizeName
methods.description: Sanitizes and potentially modifies the filename during upload to prevent security issues, handling extension checks, null byte removal, and filename munging.
